verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes a well-documented public REST API (eSign REST API docs, Developer Center, OpenAPI/Swagger specs used to generate SDKs like the Node.js client), with community confirmation that thorough API-driven integrations (e.g., embedded signing) work well in production. This directly satisfies programmatic/API-driven use, though one community report describes a security workaround requiring a legacy API version, and there's no first-party llms.txt or discoverable openapi.json at the expected probe URLs. Missing for 10: a clean machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard endpoint (probe returned 404s) and stronger independent corroboration beyond one HN thread.
